items.q: Well, after I met Ellis when he had just come in for a tour with Norman Brownlee's band.

ctx.x: So many musicians down there, but the impression of the trombone is especially interesting to me. I think of somebody like, I wonder what happened to Ellis Stratkos during that period. Where was he?
